Layer 4 (sensitivity): minimum detectable effect and power

Source: R/estimateSensitivity.R
estimateSensitivity.Rd

From the null-model variance fits (estimateVariance()), computes the analytic standard error of the two-group log2 fold-change contrast per gene (SE^2 = 1/sum_A w + 1/sum_B w, w = 1/(1/mu + phi_total)), the minimum detectable effect at the target power and FDR, and the power at the primary target effect. Summarises to the sensitivity fraction: the share of testable genes detectable at targetLFC. Uncalibrated in the MVP (calibrate = FALSE); the empirical calibration from E2/E7 is applied in a later phase.

Usage

estimateSensitivity(
  variance,
  targetLFC = 1,
  power = 0.8,
  fdr = 0.05,
  pi1 = 0.05,
  calibrate = FALSE
)

Arguments

variance

The list returned by estimateVariance().

targetLFC

Primary target absolute log2 fold-change for the call. Default 1.

power

Target power. Default 0.8.

fdr

Target FDR. Default 0.05.

pi1

Assumed fraction of true positives (maps FDR to a per-gene threshold, Jung 2005). Default 0.05.

calibrate

Reserved; must be FALSE in the MVP.

Value

A data.frame, one row per comparison, with target_lfc, sensitivity_fraction, median_mde and median_power.
